subject: CloudMart marketplace addendum — pass-through & audit items
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@cloudmart.it>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-09 08:11:00 +0000
Subject: Marketplace addendum — invoice routing & pass-through clarifications

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week. CloudMart is moving this listing toward the March intake and legal asked us to close the pass-through language and invoice ownership for the reseller addendum. Attached is our partner paper (CloudMart_PartnerPaper_v2.docx) with the terms our procurement team expects.

Key items they flagged:
- Who receives the invoice (CloudMart vs end-customer) for Marketplace sales and how refunds are routed.
- Confirmation that taxes / VAT are passed through and Redwood will provide documentation on request.
- Audit and evidence process for any revenue reconciliation (CloudMart needs 24 months of traceability).

Can you confirm Redwood's standard positions on these and whether the MSA/order form needs localized VAT language for EU sellers? If helpful we can jump on a short call.

Regards,
Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Partnerships — CloudMart
elena.rossi@cloudmart.it

Attachment: CloudMart_PartnerPaper_v2.docx
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@cloudmart.it>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-09 12:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum — invoice routing & pass-through clarifications

Hi Elena — thanks for the doc and the clear callouts.

Short answers up front:
- Invoice ownership: we typically invoice the marketplace operator (CloudMart) when transacting through a marketplace connector; however, we can support reseller flows where the end-customer is invoiced directly if required by local tax rules.
- Taxes/VAT: Redwood will pass-through taxes and provide the tax breakdown on invoices; for EU we can include VAT-facing line items and customer VAT IDs.
- Audit: we can provide reconciliation reports and transactional evidence, but need to confirm retention windows and what level of attestation your procurement needs.

I'll loop legal to produce a redline back to your partner paper with our positions flagged. Can you share the procurement SLA expectations (evidence format: CSV, PDF attestation, API log links)?

Proposed next step: internal redline from us by EOD tomorrow and a 30-min sync the day after to resolve any carve-outs.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Strategic GTM — Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.com

Attachment: RNW_addendum_questions.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-09 15:20:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: CloudMart partner paper — redline request

Hannah / Ben / Karthik — forwarding CloudMart's partner paper. I reviewed the sections Elena highlighted.

Action items for RNW legal (Karthik):
1) Draft a redline to CloudMart_PartnerPaper_v2.docx limited to: invoice owner table, tax pass-through clause, audit/evidence scope, and data retention. Avoid touching indemnities or IP sections unless requested.
2) Propose specific wording for a 12-month vs 24-month retention tradeoff (Finance will weigh in).
3) Include a fallback statement for escrow or third-party attestation if CloudMart requires a longer audit window.

Ben — pls confirm commercial flexibility on invoice ownership and whether we can accept CloudMart invoicing customers directly for EU transactions. If not today, flag the blockers.

I attached an internal redline template and included inline comments where we should push back.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Commercial Contracts — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: RNW_Marketplace_Addendum_Redlines_20280309.docx
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@cloudmart.it>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-10 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum — invoice routing & pass-through clarifications

Elena — thanks for raising these items and for the partner paper. Quick commercial note: we are comfortable routing invoice ownership to CloudMart for marketplace-connected transactions where CloudMart handles payment processing. For cases where CloudMart requires the end-customer to be invoiced (e.g., specific EU procurement rules), we can accommodate but will ask for a simple reconciliation bandwidth + standard evidence feed (CSV with invoice id, order id, net/gross, tax).

Can we do a 30-minute sync tomorrow 14:00 CET to walk the redline? If that works for you we will send an updated doc pre-read. In parallel, our legal will provide firm edits on retention and audit scope.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Director, Marketplace Partnerships — Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

Attachment: none
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@cloudmart.it>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Bianchi <m.bianchi@cloudmart.it>
Date: 2028-03-10 16:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum — invoice routing & pass-through clarifications

Ben / Hannah — 14:00 CET tomorrow works for us (calendar invite to follow). Two quick clarifications from procurement:
- Audit scope: CloudMart requires 24 months of transactional evidence, but we will accept 12 months if Redwood provides a quarterly attestation and agrees to keep detailed logs for an additional 12 months accessible on request.
- Invoice flow: CloudMart prefers to receive the invoice when they are the marketplace operator; when the end-customer must be invoiced directly we expect a pass-through statement and a reconciliation feed delivered monthly.

I've attached a short slide deck our procurement team uses to show evidence expectations (CM_Audit_Slides.pdf). We'll review the redline at the sync and try to resolve the retention tradeoff.

Thanks — speak tomorrow.

Best,
Elena

Attachment: CM_Audit_Slides.pdf
